name: laytime-statement
title: DRAFT: Laytime statement
for_each: select p.id,p.code from port_calls p join latest_calculations c on c.port_id=p.id where p.reviewed and c.revision=p.revision and c.direction<>'REVIEW' order by p.code

sections.title: Calculation for review
sections.note: Working-time-saved despatch only. Separately settled port call. No claim has been sent or lodged.

sections.title: Interval ledger
sections.sql: select x->>'from' starts_at,x->>'to' ends_at,x->>'minutes' minutes,x->>'kind' kind,x->>'reason' reason from latest_calculations c, jsonb_array_elements(c.intervals) x where c.port_id=$1

sections.title: Reviewed exceptions
sections.sql: select starts_at,ends_at,reason,clause_ref,on_demurrage from active_exceptions where port_id=$1 order by starts_at

name: claim-dossier
title: DRAFT: Claim evidence dossier
for_each: select id,code from voyages order by code

sections.title: Current position
sections.sql: select r.* from claim_round r join voyages v on r.voyage=v.code where v.id=$1

sections.title: Evidence already recorded
sections.note: Evidence references are recorded by the operator and are not independently authenticated.
sections.sql: select kind,occurred_at,reference,actor from claim_records where voyage_id=$1 order by occurred_at

sections.title: Follow-up notes
sections.sql: select body,actor,created_at from notes where voyage_id=$1 order by created_at
